Products Overview

# Together Products

Accelerate inference, model shaping, and pre-training on a research-optimized platform.

## Inference

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69654e88dce9154b5f1206dd/69a81de10b00730fd519bee7_homepage-Serverless%20Inference.avif)

Serverless Inference

The fastest way to run open-source models on demand. Powered by cutting-edge inference research. No infrastructure to manage, no long-term commitments.

[Learn more](https://www.together.ai/serverless-inference) [read docs](https://docs.together.ai/docs/serverless-models)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69654e88dce9154b5f1206dd/69a4ddeb07912b16e2a56db9_homepage-Batch%20Inference.avif)

Batch Inference

Cost-effectively process massive workloads asynchronously. Scale to 30 billion tokens per model with any serverless model or private deployment.

[Learn more](https://www.together.ai/batch-inference) [read docs](https://docs.together.ai/docs/batch-inference#batch)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69654e88dce9154b5f1206dd/69a4dde4b3ff1de50e86a713_homepage-Dedicated%20Model%20Inference.avif)

Dedicated Model Inference

Deploy models on dedicated infrastructure. Purpose-built for teams who need speed, control, and the best economics in the market.

[Learn more](https://www.together.ai/dedicated-model-inference) [read docs](https://docs.together.ai/docs/dedicated-inference)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69654e88dce9154b5f1206dd/69a4ddece79251e051ff2a43_homepage-Dedicated%20Container%20Inference.avif)

Dedicated Container Inference

GPU infrastructure purpose-built for generative media workloads. Deploy video, audio, and image models with performance acceleration powered by Together Research.

[Learn more](https://www.together.ai/dedicated-container-inference) [read docs](https://docs.together.ai/docs/dedicated-container-inference)

## Compute

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69654e88dce9154b5f1206dd/69a4dde679af0e495c4c58dc_homepage-Accelerated%20Compute.avif)

Accelerated Compute

Scale from self-serve instant clusters to thousands of GPUs, all optimized for better performance with Together Kernel Collection.

[Learn more](https://www.together.ai/accelerated-compute) [read docs](https://docs.together.ai/docs/gpu-clusters-overview)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69654e88dce9154b5f1206dd/69a4dde797dc94948db8a087_homepage-Sandbox.avif)

Sandbox

Use fast, secure code sandboxes at scale to set up full-scale development environments for AI apps and agents.

[Learn more](https://www.together.ai/sandbox) [read docs](https://docs.together.ai/docs/together-code-sandbox#together-code-sandbox)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69654e88dce9154b5f1206dd/69a4ddec9c4d979bb19ac677_homepage-Managed%20Storage.avif)

Managed Storage

High-performance managed storage for AI-native workloads. Object storage and parallel filesystems optimized for AI, with zero egress fees.

[Learn more](https://www.together.ai/managed-storage) [read docs](https://docs.together.ai/docs/cluster-storage#cluster-storage)

## Model Shaping

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69654e88dce9154b5f1206dd/69a4ddebec57cf61ac402e4f_homepage-Fine-Tuning.avif)

Fine-Tuning

Fine-tune open-source models for production workloads, using the latest research techniques. Improve accuracy, reduce hallucinations, and control behavior — without managing training infrastructure.

[Learn more](https://www.together.ai/fine-tuning) [read docs](https://docs.together.ai/docs/fine-tuning-quickstart)
